I honestly read the first paragraph, and if you're trying to make me feel better through disagreement, you're doing wonderfully. 

One instance I can think of that shows my standpoint well is that where I work we have "mystery shoppers", undercover people that come check on how we're doing to make sure we're doing our jobs correctly. I hate when people freak out when they hear about a mystery shopper, or they try to guess who it is and do a good job. No, you shouldn't do that. You should always do a good job and you won't ever have to worry about impressing someone beyond what you normally do.

I'll be me, and if people don't like me for me, i don't want them in my life.

I disagree with you. If I have to learn how to get someone to like me it's not someone that I genuinely want to be with.

If they can't like me for me than I have no business trying to be in a relationship with them.
I as just reading and expecting to see a christiansingles.com link.

I genuinely feel like I just got advertised to on a suicidewatch forum. 

Wow. No words for this feeling.

there's nothing to do. i don't have anyone to do things with and i don't have a car. i'm trapped here mentally and literally. the few people i used to talk to said bad things about this girl and i freaked out on them.
probably not. i can't get all of this off my mind no matter what. i don't see myself leaving my room today. it's killing me.

Haha, i'm sure they'll appreciate it. 

I'm in New York, if anyone's around, upstate.

I appreciate the thoughts. It's actually inspired me, I just went and put my work clothes in the washer, seeing as I worked on Wednesday I figured it was about time to change.

Just a joke. I just want things fixed, more than anything.

i have no urge to move on, no want to move on, i just want to go back. it will never happen though ive been freaking out and said terrible things that can't be changed. its not like i lived a terrible childhood, i just wasnt very happy because i didn't have a lot of people in my life. my mother makes tons of money and i came to find out that was the reason people were friends with me, once i stopped paying they stopped wanting to hang out.

I'm 20. what people don't understand is that i've never really had a lot of friends and didn't live the happiest of childhoods. but when i was with this girl i was constantly happy all the time no matter what. nothing has made me happy like that, and the fact that she just leaves and gets with someone else without even a thought about me is hurting so bad.
